1: Channels restorative energy to mend your own wounds. A foundational healing prayer that grows stronger with practice.
2: Extends healing light to a single ally, restoring their health. More effective than self-healing but requires a target.
3: Calls upon deep reserves of faith to deliver a powerful burst of healing to an ally. A cornerstone of any healer's arsenal.
4: Hurls a small bolt of fire that ignites the target, dealing damage on impact and burning for 50% of the hit damage every 2 seconds over 6 seconds.
5: Calls down a crackling bolt of thunder upon a single target, dealing direct damage.
7: A practiced healing prayer that restores a moderate amount of health to an ally.
8: An advanced healing technique that mends significant wounds on a single target.
9: Shakes the earth beneath your foes, dealing heavy damage to a single target. The ground itself becomes your weapon.
10: Launches a roaring fireball that explodes on impact, dealing damage and leaving the target burning for 30% of the hit damage every 2 seconds over 6 seconds.
12: Wraps the caster in a minor protective ward that absorbs up to 30 damage for 30 seconds. Absorb amount scales with spell level and healing power. 40s cooldown.
13: Surrounds the caster with a shield of faith that absorbs up to 60 damage for 45 seconds. Scales with spell level and healing power. 55s cooldown.
14: Sends a wave of bitter cold at the target, dealing damage and chilling them to the bone. 12s cooldown.
15: Conjures a volatile sphere of arcane energy that strikes the target and continues to pulse, dealing 40% of the hit damage every 2 seconds over 8 seconds.
16: Unleashes a blast of frost in all directions, damaging a single target and leaving them freezing for 30% of the hit damage every second for 3 seconds. 25s cooldown.
17: Plays an inspiring melody that bolsters nearby allies. The song's effects vary with the performer's skill.
18: Channels holy energy into a defensive strike, dealing damage while fortifying the caster's resolve.
19: Engulfs the target in searing flames, dealing significant fire damage.
20: Unleashes a burst of divine wrath upon the target, dealing heavy holy damage.
21: Calls down a devastating storm of meteors upon the target, dealing massive damage. The pinnacle of offensive priest magic.
22: Summons a furious blizzard that tears into the target with ice and wind, dealing devastating damage.
23: Erects a divine barrier around the caster that absorbs up to 100 damage for 60 seconds. Scales with spell level and healing power. 70s cooldown.
24: Sends a wave of healing energy through the entire party, restoring health to all members on the same map.
25: Cloaks the caster in a radiant aegis of light that absorbs up to 150 damage for 60 seconds. Scales with spell level and healing power. 75s cooldown.
26: Summons spectral tentacles that lash out at the target, dealing damage.
28: Calls forth a raging tempest that devastates the target with elemental fury. One of the most powerful offensive spells known.
29: Invokes a sanctuary of divine protection that absorbs up to 200 damage for 60 seconds. The strongest personal shield available. Scales with spell level and healing power. 80s cooldown.
32: Unleashes a torrent of raw arcane energy that tears through the target, dealing heavy damage and continuing to ravage them for 25% of the hit damage every 2 seconds over 6 seconds.
33: Ensnares the target in magical bindings, immobilizing them for 5 seconds. Useful for controlling dangerous foes. 10s cooldown.
34: Lets out a thunderous battle cry that draws the attention of all enemies within 10 tiles, forcing them to attack you. Essential for protecting allies.
35: Issues a direct challenge to a single enemy, forcing it to focus its attacks on you. Deals minimal damage but guarantees aggro.
40: Enters a state of battle recovery, regenerating 8 HP per second for 10 seconds. Healing scales with your Strength. 30s cooldown.
41: Lets out a fearsome war cry that empowers your attacks, increasing minimum damage by 5 and maximum damage by 10 for 15 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 60s cooldown.
42: Steels yourself for battle, increasing your armor by 15 for 20 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 60s cooldown.
43: Enters a bloodthirsty frenzy, stealing 15% of your damage as health for 15 seconds. Healing per hit is capped at 5% of your maximum HP. 45s cooldown.
44: Taps into natural vitality, regenerating 6 HP per second for 10 seconds. Healing scales with your Agility. 30s cooldown.
45: Fires an arrow coated in deadly poison that deals damage on impact and continues to poison the target for 40% of the hit damage every 2 seconds over 10 seconds.
46: Heightens your reflexes, increasing your evasion by 20 for 15 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 60s cooldown.
47: Marks the target with a hunter's sigil, causing it to take 15% more damage from all sources for 10 seconds. 25s cooldown.
48: Calls upon divine favor to reduce all incoming damage by 25% for 10 seconds. 60s cooldown.
49: Channels holy energy to weaken the target, reducing its outgoing damage by 20% for 12 seconds. 30s cooldown.
50: Channels a beam of holy light to heal a single ally. A versatile healing spell available to all classes.
51: Bestows a protective blessing upon all party members, granting each a shield that absorbs up to 50 damage for 30 seconds. Scales with spell level and healing power. 45s cooldown.
52: Consecrates the ground around the target, dealing 10-20 base damage to all enemies within 2 tiles. Damage scales with spell level. 30s cooldown.
53: Wraps yourself in a barrier of mana, redirecting 50% of incoming damage to your TP instead of HP for 20 seconds. 60s cooldown.
54: Infuses yourself with arcane knowledge, increasing Intelligence by 10 and Wisdom by 10 for 30 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 45s cooldown.
55: Curses the target with arcane vulnerability, causing it to take 15% more damage from spells for 15 seconds. 45s cooldown.
56: Encases yourself in a barrier of ice that absorbs up to 80 damage for 30 seconds. Scales with spell level and healing power. 45s cooldown.
57: Blesses all party members with divine strength, increasing STR by 8 for 60 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 90s cooldown.
58: Blesses all party members with divine wisdom, increasing WIS by 8 for 60 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 90s cooldown.
59: Blesses all party members with divine agility, increasing AGI by 8 for 60 seconds. Buff strength scales with spell level. 90s cooldown.
60: Fills the entire party with divine inspiration, increasing experience gained by 15% for 120 seconds. 120s cooldown.
61: Purifies a single ally, cleansing all negative effects and debuffs. 15s cooldown.
